meta.name: business-intelligence
meta.description: Builds reporting and self-serve analytics that people actually use — metric trees, dashboard design, distribution, and the discipline that stops dashboards proliferating. Use this to build a dashboard or report, design a metrics framework, set up self-serve analytics, decide what to measure, or diagnose why reporting exists but nobody uses it or trusts it.

copy.tagline: 打造真正被团队使用的数据看板与指标体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果报表很多但没人看,想建起团队真正在用的分析体系。
copy.tagline_en: Build dashboards and metrics frameworks people actually use.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has dashboards nobody uses and you want metrics people trust.

howto.what: 构建报表与自助分析：从决策出发，用指标树分解指标，遵循一屏一问、先给答案、有对比、标注异常等设计原则，并维护数据信任。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建仪表盘/报告、设计指标框架、设置自助分析等，或诊断报表为何无人使用/不被信任时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个仪表盘，先明确它要支持什么决策。
say.note: Claude会先和你确认决策，再开始设计。

say.text: 用指标树把“收入”拆解成驱动因素。
say.note: Claude会展示收入=客户数×客单价等分解。

say.text: 这个报表的“好”怎么定义？需要什么对比？
say.note: Claude会指导你设定对比基准和好坏的判断标准。

howto.what_en: Helps design dashboards and reports: start from the decision, decompose metrics into a tree, follow design principles (one question per screen, lead with the answer, always compare, annotate anomalies), and maintain trust.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a dashboard/report, design a metric framework, set up self-serve analytics, or diagnose why existing reporting is unused or mistrusted.

say_en.text: Design me a dashboard, starting with what decision it supports.
say_en.note: Claude will clarify the decision before designing.

say_en.text: Break down 'revenue' into a metric tree.
say_en.note: Claude will show drivers like customers × average value.

say_en.text: What does 'good' mean for this report? What comparison?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on benchmarks and comparisons.
